findings.title: Log mask and rotation untested
findings.detail: core/storage.ts log() masks 32-hex values as the secret backstop and openLog rotates main.log at 5 MB; neither has a test, although Ponytail asks security paths to leave a runnable check.
findings.action: Add one node:test case on a mkdtemp dir (masked hash, rotation of a >5 MB main.log) before 2.3/2.4 route the API hash through main.

findings.title: No-op frame-ancestors in the meta CSP
findings.detail: electron.vite.config.ts injects the CSP as a <meta http-equiv> tag; CSP ignores frame-ancestors there and Chromium logs a console message for it.
findings.action: Drop frame-ancestors from the meta policy and from ARCHITECTURE > Security, or note that it is inert.

findings.title: FileGram ignore rules left in .gitignore
findings.detail: .td_database/, .td_files/, .management_uploads/, .filegram_state/, .thumbs/, runtime/, config.json, settings.json, .scratch/, probe-*.js, tests/screenshot|shot|probe-*.png and the UTF-16 comment describe FileGram artifacts; downloads/ and tmp/ also hide a data-in-repo regression from a plain git status.

findings.title: Install into the home folder bricks startup
findings.detail: With allowToChangeInstallationDirectory, installing into %LOCALAPPDATA%\TeleFlow makes home === appDir, so resolvePaths throws on every launch and the error box tells an end user to set TELEFLOW_HOME.
findings.action: Word the message for end users too (reinstall into another folder), or record the limit in PRODUCT.

findings.title: Electron fuses left at defaults
findings.detail: No electronFuses config, so the shipped TeleFlow.exe honors ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE and NODE_OPTIONS. Low practical risk for an unsigned per-user binary; test:app needs the inspector arguments, so enableNodeCliInspectArguments must stay on.
findings.action: Decide in Phase 6 whether to flip runAsNode and enableNodeOptionsEnvironmentVariable (checking test:app still attaches) and record it in the Decision log.

findings.title: Doc drift on the bridge and the Electron download
findings.detail: ARCHITECTURE > Bridge snippet shows pageKey and the 403 inside ipcMain.handle, while the code does it in handleCall. README and the Early-risk 'npm 12 install scripts' row say test:app / Playwright _electron triggers the Electron binary download, but app.spec.ts passes executablePath, so it never requires electron.
findings.action: Update the Bridge snippet to show the main.ts / handleCall split, and limit the download trigger to npm run dev and node -e "require('electron')".
